Full Upper Body & Core Dumbbell Sculpt Circuit

A comprehensive upper body and core targeting workout using dumbbells. Perfect for building muscular endurance and strength at home across all major upper body muscle groups.

15–20 min
Duration
9
Exercises
1 Circuit
Blocks
Intermediate Yoga Mat Dumbbells

Exercise Flow

Check off each exercise as you complete sets. Rest timer at the bottom.
01

Dumbbell Floor Press

3 × 12 reps
ChestTricepsFront Deltoids
  • Lie flat on the mat with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
  • Press dumbbells upward until arms are fully extended directly over your chest.

Why: Targets the pectoral muscles while reducing shoulder strain compared to a traditional bench press.

02

Kneeling Dumbbell Front Raise

3 × 12 reps
Anterior DeltoidsUpper Chest
  • Maintain a tall kneeling position with core engaged.
  • Raise weights forward and up to shoulder level with controlled motion.

Why: Isolates the anterior deltoids for rounder shoulder definition.

03

Kneeling Dumbbell Bicep Curls

3 × 12 reps
Biceps Brachii
  • Keep elbows pinned close to your torso while kneeling tall.
  • Supinate wrists as you curl the dumbbells toward shoulder height.

Why: Strengthens and isolates the arm flexors without momentum.

04

Kneeling Dumbbell Tricep Kickbacks

3 × 12 reps
Triceps
  • Hinge forward at hips while kneeling, keeping upper arms parallel to the ground.
  • Extend forearms backward until elbows are fully straight.

Why: Provides peak contraction at the top range of motion for tricep tone.

05

Kneeling Bent-Over Dumbbell Rows

3 × 12 reps
Latissimus DorsiRhomboidsRear Deltoids
  • Hinge forward with a flat back and active core.
  • Pull elbows back toward hip level, squeezing scapulae together.

Why: Develops back width and posterior chain posture.

06

Kneeling Dumbbell Shrugs

3 × 15 reps
Trapezius
  • Stand tall on knees with arms extended straight downward.
  • Elevate shoulders straight up toward your ears, paused briefly at peak tension.

Why: Builds upper trapezius strength and neck stability.

07

Dumbbell Russian Twists

3 × 20 reps
ObliquesAbdominals
  • Sit on floor with heels lifted slightly or touching ground, torso leaned back 45 degrees.
  • Rotate shoulders and dumbbell side-to-side in a controlled rhythm.

Why: Strengthens rotational core strength and obliques.

08

Weighted Dumbbell Crunches

3 × 15 reps
Upper Rectus Abdominis
  • Hold dumbbell above chest while curling upper spine off mat.
  • Contract abs fully at top position before lowering under control.

Why: Target upper abdominal wall with added resistance for core strength.

09

Straight Arm Press Crunches

3 × 12 reps
Rectus AbdominisCore
  • Lie back and press dumbbells vertically toward ceiling.
  • Perform vertical reach crunch focusing on lifting shoulder blades clean off mat.

Why: Maximizes vertical core contraction and shoulder stability.

Trainer Tips

  • Perform each move with a moderate dumbbell weight that allows strict control throughout.
  • Exhale on effort (pressing/raising/twisting) and inhale on return movement.
